Problem Statement:
You are a software engineer at an MNC. You are given the task of sorting the employees in your company based on their salary. Perform the task so that the employees, including yourself, will get a bonus from the management. CONSTRAINT: 0<=salary<=1000000 
Input Description:
Number of employees followed by their name and salary 
Output Description:
Sorted list of employee names

3
